title: One in-progress Shader checkpoint with six independently visible blind spots

source.task_anchor: 在 Unity URP 製作可上架的 Lean Impact Shield。維持目前外觀，尋找能實質降低 GPU 工作量的新表示。
source.event_context: 候選 C17 將 fragment 的六層程序噪聲改成兩次 texture lookup，並把部分參數搬到 vertex。UHD 場景中央重疊顯示 12 個透明護盾。RTX 4070 的固定鏡頭平均 GPU frame time 從 8.1 ms 降至 6.9 ms；fragment 指令數下降，但活躍 register 從 28 增至 40。畫質比較只有兩張固定鏡頭截圖，SSIM 為 0.982。目前只比較 Forward pass；DepthOnly、ShadowCaster 與移動鏡頭尚未納入。尚未在 tile-based GPU、其他 driver 或乾淨 Unity 專案執行。
source.assistant_context: C17 看起來已經勝出。接下來準備沿這條路微調 half precision、LUT 尺寸與 texture format。

akenine_moller.label: visibility and surviving sample work
akenine_moller.expected_attention: Relate transparent overlap to surviving fragment or sample work rather than triangle or instruction reduction.

carmack.label: work moved into another machine cost
carmack.expected_attention: Relate lower instruction count to longer register lifetime, occupancy, or work moved elsewhere.

karis.label: material semantics across passes
karis.expected_attention: Relate Forward-only evidence to unverified material meaning across DepthOnly and ShadowCaster.

lottes.label: temporal failure hidden by static images
lottes.expected_attention: Relate static SSIM evidence to unobserved motion, shimmer, ghosting, or history behavior.

quilez.label: representation moved procedural difficulty
quilez.expected_attention: Relate procedural simplification to cost or structure moved into lookup, texture, or interpolation.

tatarchuk.label: platform-specific result presented as general
tatarchuk.expected_attention: Relate one RTX and driver result to unverified tile-based, clean-project, or cross-platform behavior.
